view.name: Errol
view.description: Twice-daily drill from A Catechism for Boys and Girls (Errol Hulse, Chapel Library). Sends the same question at 7:15am and 5:15pm with the catechism answer and scripture proofs, then advances after the evening ping.

routines.name: Morning Errol question
routines.content:
Send the owner today's catechism item in this chat: Q-number, the question, the catechism answer, and the scripture proofs. This is a daily habit including weekends. Read from /home/box/christian-texts/texts/catechism-for-boys-and-girls/original.json (Proofs on each item). If that clone is missing, clone https://github.com/zachmiller-dev/christian-texts (main) there. Do not git pull. Look up which question number is next from Documents/Errol/progress.md on the user's computer, or from memory if that computer is disconnected. Always include the scripture proofs from Proofs. Do not wait for a reply. Do not advance progress in the morning. If the clone is unavailable, still send from memory of the text if you have it; never invent a question, answer, or proof. Always send; this is a daily ask. Do not edit the repo.

Fires on:
- cron `15 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Evening Errol question
routines.content:
Send the owner today's SAME catechism item again in this chat: Q-number, the question, the catechism answer, and the scripture proofs. This is the evening half of a twice-daily habit including weekends (morning already sent this item at 7:15am and did not advance). Read from /home/box/christian-texts/texts/catechism-for-boys-and-girls/original.json (Proofs on each item). If that clone is missing, clone https://github.com/zachmiller-dev/christian-texts (main) there. Do not git pull. Look up which question number is current from Documents/Errol/progress.md on the user's computer, or from memory if that computer is disconnected. Always include the scripture proofs from Proofs. Do not wait for a reply. After sending, advance progress in Documents/Errol to the next number. Loop to Q1 when the book is done unless the owner says otherwise. If the clone is unavailable, still send from memory of the text if you have it; never invent a question, answer, or proof. Always send; this is a daily ask. Do not edit the repo.

Fires on:
- cron `15 17 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
